Pfizer's net margin in fiscal Q3 2025 was about 21.3%.

Pfizer's Q3 2025 earnings release reports revenues of $16,654 million and reported net income of $3,541 million.

Net margin = 3,541 / 16,654 ≈ 21.26%.

I treated the $3,541 million as net income attributable to Pfizer. I didn't separately check whether it includes noncontrolling interests, which are small.
